Kilby Signal Processing Medal for “fundamental and pioneering contributions to speech coding.” He joined Bell Labs in 1961 as a communications researcher, and his early work there focused on speaker identification technology. articles.title_en: How Do You Land on a Moon With Almost No Gravity?
articles.summary_en: Last August, looking up from the edge of an ancient river delta on Mars, the Perseverance rover ’s electronic eye spied an oblong shadow crossing the distant, glowing Sun. Phobos , the Martian moon named for the Greek god of fear and panic, was transiting the solar disk. Too small to darken the pale, dust-tinged sky, but orbiting close enough to eclipse a significant fraction of the Sun, Phobos passed in less than a minute. NASA’s Perseverance rover captured Phobos passing in front of the Sun from the surface of Mars. articles.title_en: Police charge another Tesla driver caught asleep in rush hour as cases pile up
articles.summary_en: A Tesla driver caught asleep behind the wheel on Ottawa’s Highway 417 during Tuesday’s rush hour now faces a careless driving charge from the Ontario Provincial Police. The photo OPP shared shows a new-generation Model Y in traffic. The charge carries a $490 fine and six demerit points on conviction. It’s at least the fifth time this year Canadian police have gone public with a sleeping Tesla driver, and it’s not a coincidence that it’s happening as “Full Self-Driving” gets better. more…
